Yes, this fallback is right. When the app can't reach the page to grab its details, it doesn't just fail and leave me stuck — it's honest that it couldn't collect anything, and then still lets me save the link by giving it a name I'll recognize, with the description as an optional extra. That matters, because a link I can't auto-fill is often exactly the kind I most want to keep, so I wouldn't want the whole save blocked just because the automatic part didn't work.

And your assumption about the missing icon or picture is exactly what I'd want too — if there's no image or favicon to be had, it should just quietly go without one, not refuse to save. The address is valid, so the bookmark should still be mine to keep. This handles the awkward case gracefully.
